title: A knowledge-driven nonconvex square-root regularization framework for joint group sparsity and structured smoothness
abstract: arXiv:2610.35428v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structured sparse learning is a leading paradigm for high-dimensional data modeling, as it enables rigorous integration of domain-validated structural priors into the learning process. Among these priors, pre-defined grouped structure and piecewise smoothness are ubiquitous in real-world applications. However, most existing structured regularization methods are built on squared loss and convex penalties, rarely jointly model these two complementary structural priors, and suffer from two key limitations. Their optimal tuning parameters are sensitive to the unknown noise level $\sigma$ due to the squared loss. Meanwhile, convex penalties induce inherent estimation bias and severe over-shrinkage of large magnitudes. To address these issues, we propose a knowledge-driven Nonconvex Structured Smooth Adjustment for Square-Root Regularization (NS$^3$R), which unifies the $\sigma$-free square-root loss with a joint nonconvex $\ell_{2,q}$ penalty

translated_title: 一种知识驱动的非凸平方根正则化框架，用于联合组稀疏性与结构化平滑
translated_abstract: 结构化稀疏学习是高维数据建模的主流范式，因为它能够将经过领域验证的结构先验严格地融入学习过程。在这些先验中，预先定义的分组结构和分段平滑性在现实应用中无处不在。然而，大多数现有的结构化正则化方法都建立在平方损失和凸惩罚之上，很少联合建模这两种互补的结构先验，且存在两个关键局限：由于使用平方损失，其最优调参对未知噪声水平 σ 高度敏感；同时，凸惩罚会引入固有的估计偏差，并对大幅值系数产生严重的过度收缩。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种知识驱动的非凸结构化平滑调整平方根正则化方法（NS³R），该方法将不依赖 σ 的平方根损失与联合非凸 ℓ₂,ₚ 惩罚统一起来。
tldr: 提出了一种知识驱动的非凸平方根正则化框架NS³R，通过将不依赖噪声水平的平方根损失与联合非凸ℓ₂,ₚ惩罚相结合，实现对组稀疏性与结构化平滑的联合建模，克服了传统平方损失对噪声敏感以及凸惩罚导致估计偏差和大幅值过度收缩的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes NS³R, a knowledge-driven nonconvex square-root regularization framework that unifies a σ-free square-root loss with a joint nonconvex ℓ₂,ₚ penalty to simultaneously capture group sparsity and structured smoothness, overcoming the noise sensitivity of squared loss and the estimation bias and over-shrinkage caused by convex penalties.
